Otian AI · Meet Archie

The inbox, the bills, the prescriptions, the birthdays. One agent, on your own computer.

Archie is a desktop app that runs your own AI agent. An add-on is one job you hand it, and there are 151 today. Below is what they cover, and where the rows are still blank.

What it covers

Name a part of your week. It is on the list, or the row is blank.

Each row is one add-on you can read today, under the name it actually has.

  • The inboxEmail Managerneeds your mail
  • The calendarCalendar Managerneeds your calendar
  • What is arrivingPackage Trackerneeds your mail
  • The school mailSchool & Familyneeds your mail
  • The billsBills & Subscriptions
  • The prescriptionsMedication & Refill Reminder
  • What the doctor actually saidHealth Record
  • The birthdaysBirthday & Anniversary Keeper
  • The people you owe a callStay in Touch
  • The house jobsHome Maintenance
  • The carCar Keeper
  • DinnerMeal Planner

And the rows that are still blank.

  • Buying it, booking it, paying itArchie cannot spend money or buy anything. It finds the flight and holds the return window; the card stays yours.
  • Your bank, read directlyBills & Subscriptions, Money In & Out and Savings Goals keep the list you give them, and connect to no bank.
  • A job huntNothing on the shelf does this yet. Commission it and you earn 25% of the proceeds from every sale after.

Where your words go

Your conversations go to your AI provider. Not to us.

Your computerArchie, your files, your keys
direct, on your own account
Your AI provideryour pick of 7, switch any time

Otian’s servers hold your email address, plan, and paid add-ons, plus the operational records on our trust page. Never a conversation. One exception: free starter credits reach Anthropic through a server of ours. We keep none of it, and connecting your own account stops it.

  • Keys in your computer’s password store
  • We never hold your conversations
  • Your own AI account, your own key
  • No analytics service in the app
  • Add-ons are text, not code
  • Nothing connects until you connect it
